findings.reason: The cited runbooks and alarms confirm the signature of a fiber cut on the link causing simultaneous site outages, supporting the inference.
The evidence shows availability dropped to 0 starting at 23:45, but active users dropped to 0 starting at 01:45, not 23:45.
T2 confirms LNK-SAH-01-A is the parent link, and T3/ALM-000335 show the critical LINK_LOS alarm at 23:53, simultaneous with the site outages.
T2 identifies the siblings, and the cited alarms show all three sites went down at 23:54 due to the shared link failure.
The cited tool outputs explicitly report no changes, maintenance, or external events for the specified nodes and time window.
